definitions.explanation: The main room in a house where the family gathers for everyday activities.

examples.english: To read a book in the living room.

examples.japanese: {居間|いま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}くて→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧。
examples.english: The living room is spacious and bright.

examples.japanese: {居間|いま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a new desk in the living room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}たち→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{居間|いま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing in the living room.

examples.japanese: {居間|いま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けたら→開ける：00563_akeru⟧、⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってきた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: When I opened the living room window, a pleasant breeze came in.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{居|い}→いる：00495_iru⟧ (to be, to stay) + ⟦{間|ま}→間：noentry⟧ (room, space). Literally "the room where one stays."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {居間|いま}: living room (traditional Japanese term)
- ⟦リビング→リビング：11198_ribingu⟧: living room (loanword, very common in modern speech)
- ⟦リビングルーム→リビングルーム：28876_ribinguruumu⟧: living room (full loanword, less common)
- ⟦{茶|ちゃ}の{間|ま}→茶の間：10660_chanoma⟧: family sitting room (traditional, associated with tatami)

REGISTER:
{居間|いま} is an ordinary, neutral everyday word. It sounds slightly more traditional than ⟦リビング→リビング：11198_ribingu⟧. In real estate listings and modern conversation, ⟦リビング→リビング：11198_ribingu⟧ or ⟦LDK→LDK：07757_erudiikee⟧ (living-dining-kitchen) is far more common.

USAGE:
In traditional Japanese houses, the {居間|いま} was the central gathering room with tatami flooring. In modern usage, it simply means the main living area regardless of style.
